visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women, one in a blue Yankees cap and white tank top and the other in a grey t-shirt, open a bright yellow and white gift box on a white table. They display exaggerated facial expressions of shock and awe as they reveal two exceptionally large, golden-skinned pears resting in white foam padding. (2) The two women pick up the massive pears and hold them close to their faces, highlighting the scale of the fruit. The woman in the blue cap smiles while the other looks on in amazement. They are in a well-lit indoor living room with dark curtains in the background. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand placing one of the pears onto a pink digital scale on a white countertop. The display flickers and shows an error code 'EEEEE', indicating the weight has exceeded the device's limit. (4) A woman with bright pink hair holds a large pear near her face, smiling broadly at the camera. She wears a white graphic t-shirt. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the smooth, speckled texture of the pear's golden skin. (5) In a kitchen setting, a man's hands use a blue peeler to remove long strips of skin from a pear over a stainless steel sink. The white, glistening flesh of the fruit is revealed. The camera angle is a tight medium close-up focusing on the action. (6) On a yellow cutting board, a man uses a large chef's knife to slice the peeled pear into thick, uniform wedges. The fruit appears firm and juicy. The background includes a modern kitchen interior with a faucet and sink. (7) An extreme close-up focuses on the sliced pear wedges, showing beads of moisture on the crisp white flesh. A metal fork is used to lift a piece, demonstrating the texture. The lighting highlights the translucency and high water content of the fruit. (8) A man in a black t-shirt eats a wedge of the pear, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. He speaks while chewing, gesturing toward the fruit. The background is a slightly out-of-focus indoor room. (9) The three women from earlier—the two younger women and the pink-haired woman—sit together and eat pear wedges from a plate using forks. They nod and appear to enjoy the flavor, creating a warm, social atmosphere in a living room. (10) The man, now wearing a blue 'TEAM TAIWAN' cap, stands behind the gift box and addresses the camera. He points to the branding on the yellow box, which features a picture of a pear and text. He speaks with an informative and enthusiastic posture.
